title: Need scripting partner
author: Historical_Staff_585
selftext:
For context I am a Roblox developer!!!  I would love a partner to work with who is proficient and very knowledgeable with AI 

I am looking for an experienced person who has made games before and who knows how to use AI to script games (please don’t message me if you’re not experienced) who wants to make simple “slop” games together (games that are simple but still fun and considered slop by the community). I am a very experienced full stack dev (I make Roblox games for a living) but I really need a good partner who can script with me (we can use AI and do it very quickly, you need to know what you’re doing and have access to pro models) you can’t be a minor must be an adult. I have lots of experience and assets to add to the equation!!! I have made extremely complex games but I’m done with that, I want to make easy games together. We can create games very quickly and work together everyday. Hit me up on discord if you’re interested matty\_97 or message me on here please - if you’re a builder, animator, artist etc I’m not interested sorry I need a scripter.

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: Why can't you just use the ai? Why do you need someone else?

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body:
They mentioned the person needs access to 'pro' models. So maybe they can't afford a subscription?

I agree with you though, not sure why someone with experience making games end to end needs a partner.

replies.author: Historical_Staff_585
replies.body: Really???? You don’t know why having a partner would be better for productivity???? Are you smoking meth???? Of course I pay for pro models, the person needs to have access to pro models just like me.

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body:
This response doesn't make you seem like someone who would be fun to work with. 

Nowhere in your post did you say why you wanted a partner. I think it's pretty reasonable to ask why.

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body:
I'm not crying about anything. Just asking reasonable questions. Did you forget you're the one who came here looking for help?

Also nearly certain I'm quite a bit older than you, kid.
